ayahs.1: Dil khush kun chalti hawaaon ki qasam.
ayahs.2: Phir zor se jhonka dene waliyon ki qasam.
ayahs.3: Phir (abr ko) ubhaar kar paraaganda karne waliyon ki qasam.
ayahs.4: Phir haq-o-baatil ko juda juda kar dene wale.
ayahs.5: Aur wahi laane wale farishton ki qasam.
ayahs.6: Jo (wahi) ilzaam utaarne ya aagaah kar dene ke liye hoti hai.
ayahs.7: Jis cheez ka tum se waada kiya jaata hai woh yaqeenan hone wali hai.
ayahs.8: Pas jab sitaare be-noor kar diye jaaenge.
ayahs.9: Aur jab aasman tod-phod diya jaayega.
ayahs.10: Aur jab pahaad tukde tukde kar ke uda diye jaaenge.
ayahs.11: Aur jab rasoolon ko waqt-e-muqarrara par laaya jaayega.
ayahs.12: Kis din ke liye (in sab ko) muakhkhar kiya gaya hai?
ayahs.14: Aur tujhe kya maloom ke faisle ka din kya hai?
ayahs.15: Us din jhutlaane walon ki kharabi hai.
ayahs.16: Kya hum ne aglon ko halaak nahin kiya?
ayahs.17: Phir hum un ke baad pichhlon ko laaye.
ayahs.18: Hum gunahgaaron ke saath isi tarah karte hain.
ayahs.19: Us din jhutlaane walon ke liye wail (afsos) hai.
ayahs.20: Kya hum ne tumhein haqeer paani se (mani se) paida nahin kiya.
ayahs.21: Phir hum ne use mazboot-o-mahfooz jagah mein rakha.
ayahs.23: Phir hum ne andaaza kiya aur hum kya khoob andaaza karne wale hain.
ayahs.24: Us din takzeeb karne walon ki kharabi hai.
ayahs.25: Kya hum ne zameen ko sameetne wali nahin banaya?
ayahs.26: Zindon ko bhi aur murdon ko bhi.
ayahs.27: Aur hum ne is mein buland-o-bhaari pahaad bana diye aur tumhein serab karne wala meetha paani pilaya.
ayahs.28: Us din jhutlaane walon ke liye waaye aur afsos hai.
ayahs.29: Us dozakh ki taraf jao jise tum jhutlaate rahe the.
ayahs.30: Chalo teen shaakhon wale saaye ki taraf.
ayahs.31: Jo dar-asl na saaya dene wala hai aur na shole se bacha sakta hai.
ayahs.32: Yaqeenan dozakh chingaariyan phenkti hai jo misl-e-mahal ke hain.
ayahs.33: Goya ke woh zard oont hain.
ayahs.34: Aaj in jhutlaane walon ki durgat hai.
ayahs.35: Aaj (ka din) woh din hai ke yeh bol bhi na sakenge.
ayahs.36: Na unhein maazrat ki ijaazat di jaayegi.
ayahs.37: Us din jhutlaane walon ki kharabi hai.
ayahs.38: Yeh hai faisle ka din, hum ne tumhein aur aglon ko sab ko jama kar liya hai.
ayahs.39: Pas agar tum mujh se koi chaal chal sakte ho to chal lo.
ayahs.40: Waaye hai us din jhutlaane walon ke liye.
ayahs.41: Beshak parhezgaar log saayon mein hain aur behte chashmon mein.
ayahs.42: Aur un mewon mein jin ki woh khwahish karen.
ayahs.43: (Ae jannatiyo!) Khao pio maze se apne kiye hue aamaal ke badle.
ayahs.44: Yaqeenan hum neki karne walon ko isi tarah jaza dete hain.
ayahs.45: Us din sachcha na jaanne walon ke liye wail (afsos) hai.
ayahs.46: (Ae jhutlaane walo) tum dunya mein thoda sa kha lo aur faayda utha lo, beshak tum gunahgaar ho.
ayahs.47: Us din jhutlaane walon ke liye sakht halaakat hai.
ayahs.48: Un se jab kaha jaata hai ke ruku kar lo to nahin karte.
ayahs.49: Us din jhutlaane walon ki tabaahi hai.
ayahs.50: Ab is Quran ke baad kis baat par imaan laaenge?
